Issue Title: Skip link missing or not focusable
Fix Summary: Add a visible-on-focus 'Skip to main content' link before header/nav; set href to #main and ensure focus moves to main region.

Issue Title: Keyboard focus indicator not visible on links/buttons
Fix Summary: Add :focus-visible styles (outline/ring) for all interactive elements; do not remove outlines without replacement.
Ensure text contrast >= 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text). Verify hover/active/disabled states as well.
Use <label for=> + id or aria-labelledby for every input/select/textarea; do not rely on placeholder as label.
Ensure UI components (icons, borders, focus rings) meet 3:1 against adjacent colors.

Issue Title: Heading order not logical (skipped levels/multiple H1s)
Fix Summary: Use one H1 per page; ensure sequential heading structure and meaningful section headings.

Issue Title: Images missing alt or decorative images not empty-alt
Fix Summary: Provide meaningful alt text for informative images; set alt='' for decorative images; ensure linked images have alt that conveys purpose.

Issue Title: Link text is generic ('Read more', 'Click here')
Fix Summary: Make link text descriptive: include whitepaper title in link text or add aria-label/aria-labelledby.
